Want to try Linux but still need Windows for a few things? In this video, I’ll show you how to set up a dual boot with Windows 11 and Ubuntu 26.10, so you can pick which one to run every time you power on your PC. We’ll go over what you’ll need, make a bootable USB drive, try out Ubuntu 26.10 before installing it, and then set up the dual boot. At the end, we’ll make sure both operating systems start up the way they should.
